Investors will be reassured that this cohort represents less than 5% of total volume, capping potential downside.

key_moments.title: Early Development Outlook Inflects Upward
key_moments.blurb: Management raised Early Development full-year revenue growth guidance from flat to low-single digits. This strategic upward revision, supported by more timely study starts and strong request-for-proposal (RFP) volumes, signals a long-awaited demand stabilization in the biotech funding ecosystem.

at_a_glance.headline: Labcorp Tops Estimates for Q2
at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp Holdings Inc. reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.731 billion, surpassing expectations of $3.714 billion, while its reported adjusted EPS reached $3.64.

at_a_glance.headline: Segment KPIs Reflect Solid Growth
at_a_glance.detail: The Diagnostics segment grew 5.5% year-over-year to $2.9 billion, and Biopharma Laboratory Services increased 6.5% to $836 million, supported by a solid book-to-bill ratio of 1.14.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year 2026 Outlook Raised
at_a_glance.detail: Management raised its full-year 2026 enterprise revenue growth guidance to a range of 5.4% to 6.3% and boosted adjusted EPS expectations to a range of $18.10 to $18.55.

at_a_glance.headline: Share Buyback Authorization Increased Significant
at_a_glance.detail: Labcorp's Board of Directors authorized a $1.0 billion expansion to its share repurchase program, bringing total remaining buyback capacity to $1.4 billion.

at_a_glance.headline: Strategic Expansion in Genetic Offerings
at_a_glance.detail: The company expanded its precision medicine footprint with advancements in its oncology screening services and the launch of Marker by Labcorp, a consumer genetic health panel.

CERT.summary: Certara reported Q2 2026 total revenue of $93.3 million, a modest 1% year-over-year growth, missing estimated revenue of $98.1 million. Software revenue grew 4% to $48.8 million, while services revenue fell 3% to $44.5 million. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.08, down from $0.08 year-over-year and missing estimates by $0.011.

key_moments.title: Aggressive AI Integration Targets Operational Costs
key_moments.blurb: The company revealed deep operational AI deployment, with 85% of new software code now AI-assisted, contributing to a 65% year-over-year increase in engineer development velocity. Automated agents are lowering legal and IT cycle times by 90%, preserving margins amidst the divestiture headwinds.

key_moments.title: Full-Year FY26 Margin Guidance Adjusted Downward
key_moments.blurb: Management lowered its full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA margin guidance to 29%–31% from 30%–32%. This revision is due to stranded corporate infrastructure costs left behind after the divestiture of the Regulatory and Medical Writing business, which will disappoint investors looking for immediate operational efficiency.

key_moments.title: NVIDIA Partnership Highlights Next-Gen Platform
key_moments.blurb: Certara detailed its recent partnership with NVIDIA, which integrates frontier AI models and the BioNeMo Agent Toolkit into Certara's software. This collaboration aims to unlock higher throughput early discovery use cases and modernize how clients interface with their regulated software solutions.

key_moments.title: Go-To-Market Model Overhaul and CCO Appointment
key_moments.blurb: CEO Jon Resnick criticized the previous generalist sales model, implementing a science-led, specialist approach that deploys PhD-heavy teams. This pivot drove a 27% pipeline increase and is paired with the appointment of Julien Perrier as Chief Commercial Officer to execute this critical commercial inflection.

at_a_glance.headline: Certara Misses EPS and Revenue Estimates
at_a_glance.detail: Certara reported a reported adjusted EPS of -$0.36, missing the estimated adjusted EPS of 0.091, while reported revenue of $93,271,000 also fell short of the estimated $98,079,000.

at_a_glance.headline: Software Resiliency Buffers Service Bookings Decline
at_a_glance.detail: Software revenue rose 4% year-over-year to $48.8 million backed by a 9% increase in quarterly bookings, which helped offset a 3% decline in services revenue to $44.5 million.

at_a_glance.headline: Full-Year Earnings Guidance Lowered Significantly
at_a_glance.detail: Certara lowered its full-year 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to a range of $0.31 to $0.36 from its previous outlook of $0.35 to $0.41, representing a notable downward adjustment for investors.

at_a_glance.headline: Divestiture Impacts Overall Corporate Structure
at_a_glance.detail: The company's financials reflect its recent strategic transformation, following the May 2026 divestiture of its regulatory and medical writing business to lean into a high-margin software model.

at_a_glance.headline: Market Reaction Triggers Sharp Sell-Off
at_a_glance.detail: Following the earnings release and lowered full-year guidance, Certara's stock plunged over 13% to 16% in early market trading as investor expectations were unmet.

at_a_glance.headline: Cost Actions and NVIDIA Partnership Leveraged
at_a_glance.detail: Management executed a 5% global reduction in force to capture $13 million in cost savings, alongside entering a new partnership with NVIDIA to deploy agentic AI tools within its biosimulation platform.
